summary: Analysis lacks eval_questions/35x20 assert on prior JSON; pod preflight gate covers production, but a --limit-questions artifact (is_stub=False) at the production out-dir passes silently.
S13.3 trunc-excl sensitivity re-aggregates only the prior side; if truncation_rate > 0 analyzer must also compute the question-matched variant (DV/margin_base on kept q's) — free from persisted data.
nvidia_smi_assert_clean warns instead of raising on surviving GPU PIDs (verbatim #478 pattern the plan names); downstream HF load fails loud, but a hard raise localizes faster.
